title: Analysis of Dietary Intake in Professional Female Football Players
official: Analysis of Dietary Intake in Professional Female Football Players: Variations According to Playing Position, Age, and Country
summary: This study evaluates the dietary intake of professional female footballers against nutritional guidelines, analysing differences by age, position, and location (UK vs Spain). Using a cross-sectional design, it will include 20-30 players per club from four clubs, aged 18+, collected via the Snap-N-Send method and analysed with Nutritics software. Variables include energy intake, macronutrients, and micronutrients, with data assessed using MANOVA, t-tests, and Shapiro-Wilk tests. The aim is to determine dietary adequacy and provide insights to improve nutrition education and wellbeing for female athletes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female or assigned female at birth
* Playing football professionally
* At a sub-elite to elite standard
* Above the age of 18
* Healthy and free of disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Active supplementation with ergogenic aids
* Active pregnancy
* No signing of the consent form
